DIAGNOSIS READY: Night Terrors.

The description of intense fear, screaming, and crying without subsequent confusion or amnesia is highly characteristic of night terrors (sleep terrors) rather than nightmares. Given the age and frequency, I will stop here as the clinical picture is sufficient for a confident diagnosis.
